verdict.rationale: Reflect's own site claims the app is open source with code on GitHub, stores notes as local Markdown files, and lets you choose your own sync (iCloud Drive or Git). That amounts to a local-first, user-controlled deployment of the core product. However, these are bare marketing lines, and the rest of the pack describes a vendor-hosted service: an API at reflect.app/api and server-side end-to-end encryption. missing for 10: self-hosting/build or deployment documentation, license details, confirmation that the full core product (not just a client) runs without Reflect's servers, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
